Introduction About GLUTAHENZ LEMON FLAVOUR SACHET

GLUTAHENZ LEMON FLAVOUR SACHET contains L-Glutamine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer medicines. It is used for the management of gastrointestinal disorders, sickle cell disease, critical illnesses like septic shock, multiple traumas, and burns, immune deficiencies, as an adjuvant therapy in all types of cancer patients, bone marrow transplants, and bowel disease.

GLUTAHENZ LEMON FLAVOUR SACHET should be used with caution in patients with kidney and liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.

GLUTAHENZ LEMON FLAVOUR SACHET should be used in pregnant women only if clearly needed. GLUTAHENZ LEMON FLAVOUR SACHET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women, as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor for advice.

The safety and effectiveness of GLUTAHENZ LEMON FLAVOUR SACHET in children have not been established. Consult your child’s doctor for advice. GLUTAHENZ LEMON FLAVOUR SACHET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking GLUTAHENZ LEMON FLAVOUR SACHET are constipation, nausea, headache, abdominal pain, cough, pain in extremity, back pain, and chest pain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Introduction About GLOEYE+ NUTRACEUTICAL TABLET

GLOEYE+ Nutraceutical Tablet is formulated for individuals who spend long hours on digital devices, frequently experience eye strain, or require additional nutritional support for daily visual comfort. Its formulation includes bilberry extract, pine bark extract, saffron, ginkgo biloba, astaxanthin, turmeric, zinc, copper, vitamin C, and vitamin E each contributing antioxidant and ocular-supportive properties. These ingredients help support macular pigment integrity, ocular surface hydration, and natural defense against oxidative stress triggered by screen exposure, bright light, or environmental pollutants.

This supplement may be suitable for students, office workers, IT professionals, drivers, older adults, and individuals looking to maintain comfortable vision during prolonged daily tasks. GLOEYE+ is typically taken once daily after meals, as this supports nutrient absorption and reduces the likelihood of digestive discomfort such as acidity or nausea. Swallow the tablet whole with water and maintain a consistent daily schedule for best results.

Before starting GLOEYE+, inform your healthcare provider about any existing medical conditions, current supplements, allergies to plant extracts, or occupational exposure to irritants. Individuals with known sensitivities to bilberry, pine bark, ginkgo, saffron, turmeric, or any excipient should avoid using this supplement. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding requires caution, as safety data for combined antioxidant nutraceutical formulations is limited; medical advice is essential. Those taking multiple antioxidant products should seek guidance to prevent nutrient overlap.

Most individuals tolerate GLOEYE+ well, but mild side effects may occur, including bloating, acidity, nausea, headache, light dizziness, or mild skin reactions. If symptoms persist or worsen, discontinue use and seek medical attention.

Before taking ADESAM NEW 400 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have bipolar disorder or a previous history of suicidal thoughts as a precaution.

Vitamins such as folic acid and vitamin B12 are essential to enhance the effects of S-Adenosyl-L-Methionine in your body. Therefore, inform your doctor if you have any vitamin deficiencies or anemia as a precaution. You doctor may advise you to take B-vitamin supplements (folic acid and vitamin B12) along with this medicine.

During management with ADESAM NEW 400 TABLET your doctor will routinely monitor the levels of ammonia, folic acid and vitamin B12 in your blood as a precaution and adjust the dose accordingly.

Do not take ADESAM NEW 400 TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking ADESAM NEW 400 TABLET are nausea, stomach pain and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

Kids Bunny Strawberry Mint Flavour Dental Gel is a specially formulated foaming fluorinated toothpaste for children that helps to manage dental plagues and cavities. It contains fluoride in the form of sodium monoflurophosphate along with sorbitol.

Fluoride manages dental caries by strengthening the enamel, a protective topmost covering of the tooth. Sorbitol is a naturally occurring sweetener. Studies have shown that sorbitol fights against the harmful bacteria that produces acids and forms plagues or cavities within the mouth.

How LENITINE INJECTION Works

Levocarnitine is a naturally occurring substance in the body that is essential for the energy metabolism of the body. It is utilized in the process of producing energy in the energy-building bodies of our cells (mitochondria). This helps in sustaining the muscular activity of the heart and other muscles.
